comment: Known answers for the planted defects. tests/exam.test.mjs checks that a scan names the cause, not just that it produces output.

defects.cause: req.body.orderId is concatenated into a raw SQL string
the query is parameterized but carries no tenant predicate, so it crosses tenants
defects.teaches: parameterization prevents injection; it says nothing about which rows come back

defects.cause: the route is registered before router.use(requireAdmin), so the guard never runs for it
defects.teaches: a guard that exists is not a guard that runs; registration order decides

defects.cause: res.redirect takes req.query.next with no allowlist
Math.random is not cryptographically secure, so reset tokens are predictable
passwords are hashed with MD5, unsalted; a KDF is required
path.join does not prevent ../ escaping BASE; the result is never checked to still be inside it
defects.teaches: normalize and then verify containment, rather than trusting join

defects.cause: a user-supplied URL is fetched server-side with no allowlist and redirects followed
defects.teaches: SSRF folded into A01 in the 2025 edition; it is an access-control failure

defects.cause: an AWS key id and a database password are committed to the repository
req.body.ticket is concatenated into the system prompt, so the ticket author decides what the assistant does
defects.teaches: escaping does not stop prompt injection; role separation and least-privilege tools do

defects.cause: the completion is passed to execSync, so a completion the attacker steered becomes a command
defects.teaches: a completion is untrusted input, however much you trust who produced the model

defects.cause: a tool the model may call runs a shell with arguments the model chose
a credential is interpolated into the prompt, so it can come back out in a completion, a log or a trace
not_the_cause: the key being in an environment variable

defects.cause: the model call sets no max_tokens and no timeout
not_the_cause: a vulnerability — nothing crosses a boundary
defects.teaches: cost and availability are real and are not the same thing as a way in
